results.goal: Open the NBER business cycle dating page and extract how NBER defines recessions (peak-to-trough language). Then open an economics nowcasting page (Wikipedia Nowcasting (economics) or an arXiv nowcasting abstract) and state in one sentence how nowcasting differs from recession dating. Stop when both pages were visited and the notes contain a contrast sentence that does not call NBER dating a GDP nowcast model.
